generation.scope: Every maximal-tangent finite AS window whose ternary relations cut out the graph on a reduced plane cubic lies in one of four geometric strata: smooth elliptic, integral nodal, transverse line-conic, or triangle. Each has two base types and all finite corrections are classified up to indexed isomorphism, including exceptional periods. Dimensions per order are 9,8,7,6 and the latter three strata smooth to the corresponding elliptic family. The tangent conic-line, concurrent lines, vertex permutations and pointwise fixed reduced components are excluded.

open_mathematics: Study nonreduced ternary graphs scheme-theoretically. At a triple point compare the derivative of the canonical three-tensor map with the cube of the tangent map. If a supporting line is fixed pointwise, use the normal linear form cutting it out to constrain the ternary relations and the binary quadratic/cubic restrictions of the mixed cochains. Also address finite edges without maximal tangent points and the independent ordinary rank-15 central-cut exceptional loci.
